text: With m2 fixed and 6000 steps, the N=64 minus N=128 force gap ranks the seeds the same way on both datasets: seed 22 is larger than seed 23 on data_seed 0 (0.143 vs 0.072) and on data_seed 1 (about 0.086 vs 0.053). Both gaps are smaller on data_seed 1. Is the gap roughly a per-seed factor multiplied by a per-dataset scale? Seed 20's small gaps (0.011 and about 0.02-0.03) and seed 21's large gaps (0.107 and 0.105) are a test case: do they fit the same multiplicative pattern?
